shortDescription: Manage data migration on VPLEX Storage System

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: The name of the source VPLEX cluster

options.name: debug
options.description: To specify whether to have debug statements from vplexapi in log file or not

options.name: migration_name
options.description: The name of the migration job

options.name: source_name
options.description: The name of the source object. The source device should contain a virtual volume. The source extent should be in 'used' state

options.name: ssl_ca_cert
options.description: SSL CA certificate file (.pem format) provided by the user to verify SSL

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the migration job should exist or not

options.name: status
options.description: The status of the migration job

options.name: storage
options.description: Defines whether the migration job is for device or extent

options.name: target_cluster
options.description: The name of the target VPLEX cluster. Only used for device migration

options.name: target_name
options.description: The name of the target object. The target device should not contain a virtual volume. The target extent should be in 'claimed' state

options.name: transfer_size
options.description: The transfer size of the migration job. Number in Bytes. Must be a multiple of 4K with range 40KB to 128M. Default value is 128KB

options.name: verifycert
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. True - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. False - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vplex_timeout
options.description: the network connectivity timeout value to connect to VPLEX host in seconds

options.name: vplexhost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the VPLEX host

options.name: vplexpassword
options.description: the password of the VPLEX host.
